# /etc/systemd/system/decider-h2o.service
[Unit]
Description=Resident H2O Lightning FP8 on shared L4
After=docker.service decider-vllm.service
Requires=docker.service
Wants=decider-vllm.service
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/decider-open-models/source/wait_ready.py 8100
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f decider-h2o-resident
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --name decider-h2o-resident --gpus all --network host --memory=8g --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 --entrypoint bash -v /opt/decider-open-models:/bench -e PATH=/bench/h2o-env/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin -e MAX_LEN=4096 -e GPU_UTIL=0.34 -e PORT=18803 -e VLLM_PORT=18802 -e MAX_IMAGES=1 -e MAX_PIXELS=65536 -e CUDA_GRAPH_MAX_TOKENS=128 -e VLLM_GDN_PREFILL_GRAPH_MAX_TOKENS=0 -e VLLM_GDN_PREFILL_GRAPH_PRECAPTURE=0 -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/bench/h2o-cache -e "VLLM_ARGS=--max-num-seqs 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 --enforce-eager --quantization fp8" sha256:0bd44d374991dc8782b93d58bb41b3aab63fa0d242149578b342cb139f371d07 /bench/models/h2o/serve.sh
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop --time 30 decider-h2o-resident
Restart=always
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=60
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
